angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 901,627 km at 109.02 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.1725 +/- 0.0221 mas (same row, RUWE 0.94): 109.02 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.296 +/- 0.058 solar radii from Barros et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 106315 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...608A..25B/abstract): 901,627 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.091 +/- 0.036 solar masses from Barros et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 106315 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...608A..25B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6327 +/- 48 K from Barros et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 106315 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...608A..25B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Barros et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 106315 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...608A..25B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-106315.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.251, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 106315 (pscomppars): spectral type F5 V, from Barros et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...608A..25B/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 106315: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 106315 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.311 dex, from Barros et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...608A..25B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 106315 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.39454, from Lendl et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...603L...5L/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 106315 (pscomppars): age 4.48 Gyr, from Barros et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...608A..25B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 106315 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 12.71 km/s, from Barros et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...608A..25B/abstract)
